list: The official 55 PlayStation 5 trophies, with a guide to each in our own words

trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work through the five roadmap stages in order — story, stranger missions, activities, collectibles, then the 100% cleanup — and use this checklist to see what is left. Guides put the whole journey at roughly 200 to 300 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first mission of the game, and the trophy pops when it ends. It is part of the story, so it cannot be missed; just keep playing and it will come to you.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. It is a story trophy, so it is unmissable — but before you leave Chapter 1, read the note on Positive Mental Attitude, the one trophy that might be missable there.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in full and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Like every chapter trophy, it unlocks automatically through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its conclusion; the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. It is a story trophy and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and the trophy pops at the end of the chapter. It is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it unlocks automatically as you play the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission and this gold trophy is yours. It is the last of the 12 story trophies, and it unlocks automatically — there is nothing extra to do, just see the story through to its ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a mission trophy, so it pops when the mission ends — keep following the story and it will unlock on its own.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. The trophy unlocks when the mission is finished; as a story mission trophy it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. The trophy pops at the end of the mission and, like the other mission trophies, it is unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a mission trophy that unlocks when the mission ends, so just play the story through and it will pop.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. The trophy unlocks on mission completion and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The trophy pops when the mission ends; it is the last of the named mission trophies and it is unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: After you finish the story, the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress (Touch Pad) with 35 tasks to complete. Progress you made during the story already counts toward it, and guides report that nothing on the checklist is missable. This is the final gold before the platinum, so save it for stage 5 and tick tasks off as you finish the other trophies.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt jumps across Leonida. Stunt jumps are the ramps and gaps scattered around the map — hit one at speed and land it cleanly for it to count. Your stunt total is tracked under Progress, so check it there and keep hunting jumps after the story until you reach 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every one of the 9 activity types the game offers, one try each. The activities include races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races, meditation spots and bowling, among others — you only need to try each once, not win or finish anything. Open the activities list in the game to see which types you still have not touched.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Head to a shooting range and work through its challenges one by one; each challenge can be retried as often as you like, so keep at a challenge until your score clears the gold line. This is the biggest skill grind of stage 3 — steady aim and the right weapon for each challenge matter more than speed.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations around Leonida. Each location has its own course, so learn the turns and the shortcuts of one course at a time and retry it until you win. Your wins are tracked per location, so you can see which courses are still unbeaten.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count only once each, so you need twenty distinct ones — vary the race types and locations instead of replaying the same favourite. Any race you win during the story or while exploring already counts toward the twenty.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing challenges are found at fishing spots around Leonida — cast where the fish are biting, watch the line, and reel in a better catch than Cal manages. If you lose, you can challenge him again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Play any arcade game through to completion. Find an arcade machine, pick a game and finish a full run of it — no high score is needed, just a completed game. Any arcade game counts, so choose one you enjoy.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand by completing its final mission. Stranger missions appear as you explore Leonida — meet Andy, work through each of his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his strand ends. This is one of the eight strands that also feed Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Find Kenton out in the world, take on his missions as they appear, and finish the last one — the trophy unlocks at the end of the strand.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand with its final mission. Meet Billy, complete his missions in order, and the trophy pops when the strand is done. Each stranger strand is self-contained, so you can do them in any order.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete all eight stranger mission strands across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and the remaining two. Each strand has its own final mission and its own trophy, so this silver pops once the eighth strand is finished. Work through the strands in stage 2, before the activity grind.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Take on Randy's missions as you find them and finish the last one to close the strand and earn the trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Work through his missions in order and the trophy unlocks when the strand's final mission is done.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. This is the one trophy guides flag as possibly missable: one guide reports a Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia adds to the counter, but whether it is required remains unclear. Protect your run by meditating at every spot you find from Chapter 1 onward, and keep a manual save before you leave Chapter 1 so you can go back if a spot turns out to be required.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret's hunting strand by tracking down and hunting the unique animal he asks for. Follow Bret's missions, use the clues he gives to find the animal's territory, and take the shot when you have it lined up. This strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Collect cards across Leonida until you have finished three full sets. Cards are found in the world and through activities — check your collection to see which cards you still need for each set, then hunt those down. Sets are completed one card at a time, so this trophy builds slowly as you explore.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations around Leonida. WAiNK spots are spread across the whole map, so this one fills in naturally as you explore every region for the other trophies — just use the feature whenever a WAiNK spot is nearby instead of walking past it. Your count is tracked under Progress.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's challenges. Challenges span activities, combat and exploration, so they pile up on their own while you chase the other trophies — races, stunts, shooting-range golds and robberies all feed the counter. Check Progress to see which challenge types you are closest on, then finish the easiest ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build up a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the police until the stars clear. Cause enough trouble to reach four stars, then break line of sight — duck into alleys, switch vehicles, or hide out of the search area — and stay hidden until the heat dies down. Having your partner along is part of the requirement, so do it during a mission or activity you tackle together.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping the same wanted level throughout. Plan a route of three nearby shops before you start, move fast between them, and keep the police pressure steady — don't lose the wanted level between robberies or the chain breaks. A fast getaway vehicle parked nearby helps a lot.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you first find and use it, so try everything you see on the road — cars, bikes, boats, planes and the oddities parked around Leonida. Your discovered total is tracked under Progress, and guides note the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this trophy comes on the way to that bigger goal.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus in a firefight with at least five enemies close together, then take down all five before the focus ends. Pick a busy fight — a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff — wait until the enemies are grouped, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them fast. If you run out of targets, retry in another big fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport. Head to VCIA, get hold of an aircraft, and take off without going through the usual channels — the trophy is about leaving the airport on your own terms. The exact trigger is not spelled out in the guides consulted, so try taking off from the airport in a plane outside of a mission and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: Get behind the controls of a Rhino tank and make use of it. The description points squarely at the Rhino, so find one — through military areas or the open world — climb in and use its firepower. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in the guides consulted, so expect it to pop from driving and firing the tank in the open world.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. Go in quiet: avoid the cameras and the guards, keep out of sight lines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — back out, let things cool down and try again with a stealthier approach.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault needs planning — a way in, a way through the vault, and a fast getaway once the alarm is up — so scout the bank first and have an escape vehicle ready. All five robberies count toward the total, and you can do them one at a time across the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Ambush an armored truck, take its cargo and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — watch for one on the road, stop it, grab what it is carrying and get clear of the police before they close in. A heavy vehicle to ram it with and a fast car for the getaway make the job much easier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: Visit every corner of Leonida — Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park — until the whole map is revealed. Drive, fly and sail into each region; the trophy pops once there is nowhere left on the map you have not been. Pair this with the WAiNK and vehicle hunts, since both take you to the same far-flung places.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Find and rob one illegal operation for every gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations around the state, so work through them gang by gang — scout an operation, hit it and get out. Your progress is per gang, so keep a note of which gangs you have already robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. This is one of the game's quiet moment trophies — no fight, no chase, just find the right spot on the beach, have a drink and take it in. The trophy should pop once the scene plays out.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through a vehicle showroom and smash your way out the other side. Pick a showroom, get a car up to speed inside or drive one straight through the front, and keep going until you burst out — the classic GTA showroom exit. The exact showroom is not yet confirmed in the guides consulted, so try the larger showrooms in Vice City first.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your throw. Head to the alley, step up to a lane and bowl — the trophy is about the follow-through, so complete a proper bowling attempt rather than just visiting. It is a low-effort trophy you can grab in minutes between bigger jobs.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.guide: This hidden trophy is tied to a partnership moment in the game — the description points at Lucia and Jason working together to win people over. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in the guides consulted, so keep playing the story and the side content with your partner and it should pop from a partnership scene. Not yet confirmed — check the cited guides for updates.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: This hidden trophy is linked to a story choice — the description suggests a decision with consequences. The exact choice is not yet confirmed in the guides consulted. As a precaution, keep a manual save before any big decision in the story so you can replay the other option if the trophy does not pop.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: This hidden trophy's name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something — retrying a failed moment until it works. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in the guides consulted, so it is flagged here rather than guessed at. If a mission or activity fails on your first try, retry it: a second-attempt success is the most likely trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.guide: This hidden trophy's description reads like a reaction to something strange — an odd or unexpected event in the world of Leonida. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed in the guides consulted, so it is flagged here rather than guessed at. Keep an eye out for unusual encounters while exploring, and check the cited guides as players pin the trigger down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock the bowling pins over with a melee drive-by at the bowling alley. Drive past the lanes with a melee weapon in hand and swing as you pass, bowling the pins over from the vehicle. The exact setup is not yet confirmed in the guides consulted, so try it at the Kolt & Associates alley — the same alley as Let's Go Bowling.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTADb — GTA 6 Trophies Platinum Guide

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the cleaned total builds toward $250,000. It accumulates naturally if you keep robbing and laundering, so treat it as a background goal while you chase the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops in Leonida. Every purchase counts — weapons, clothes, food, vehicles and property — so the total climbs as you gear up for the rest of the trophies. If you are short near the end, buy big-ticket items like vehicles to close the gap; your spending total is tracked under Progress.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available in the game. Garages are bought through the property market — check which ones you still do not own and save up for each. This is a money goal, so it pairs well with Treat Yo Self: the same spending pushes both trophies forward.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles you own to the Scooter Bros app. Collect vehicles, then open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — ten different registrations earn the trophy. Any vehicles you already own count, so this is a quick win once you have a small collection.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies
